points.K2: 过滤的用途和三种方法
points.K12: 重力过滤先折扇形滤纸
points.K19: 漏斗大小合适，放好滤纸
points.K21: 冲洗烧瓶和滤纸各三次
points.K27: 滤纸盖住底部，不上侧壁
points.K30: 用真空管路可直接连接
points.K32: 倒在中央，分次加，冲洗三次
points.K33: 关泵：没接安全瓶先拔管
points.S2: 过夜样品要标识、放指定处

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有滴管、漏斗和带抽滤瓶的布氏漏斗，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a glass dropper on a stand, a glass funnel on a flask, and a white filter funnel on a side-arm flask, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲三种过滤方法。

shots.scene: 滴管、玻璃漏斗、布氏漏斗三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a glass dropper with cotton, a glass funnel with folded paper, a white filter funnel on a side-arm flask. No people.
shots.narration: 微量过滤、重力过滤、减压过滤。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着慢慢滴的漏斗，急得直跺脚
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a slowly dripping funnel and taps his foot impatiently.
shots.narration: 阿杰嫌过滤太慢，急得团团转。

shots.scene: 满溢出漏斗的混合物图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mixture overflowing the top of a funnel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一下子倒太多，差点溢出来。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，递给阿杰一张折好的扇形滤纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, hands the young male student a neatly fluted filter paper.
shots.narration: 小研说：方法对了，自然就快。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一个沙漏，微笑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds an hourglass and smiles calmly.
shots.narration: 过滤，先要有耐心。

shots.section_title: 过滤的用途和三种方法
shots.scene: 固体留在滤纸上、液体流下的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of solid staying on a filter while liquid passes through. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤能把固体和液体分开。
overlay: 过滤的用途和三种方法

shots.section_title: 过滤的用途和三种方法
shots.scene: 脏溶液变成清溶液的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A dark cloudy solution turning into a clear solution with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 也能除去溶液里的杂质。

shots.scene: 一支细长的玻璃滴管
shots.prompt_en: A long thin glass dropper with a narrow tip. No people.
shots.narration: 少量样品，用滴管做微量过滤。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手撕下一小块棉花搓成球
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands tear off a small piece of cotton and roll it into a tiny ball. No people.
shots.narration: 撕一小块棉花，搓成小球。

shots.scene: 棉球放在滴管上口，大小正好
shots.prompt_en: The cotton ball sits on the top opening of the dropper, about the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 大小和滴管上口差不多。

shots.scene: 细金属丝把棉球往下捅
shots.prompt_en: A thin metal wire pushes the cotton ball down inside the dropper. No people.
shots.narration: 用细丝或另一支滴管往下捅。

shots.scene: 棉球卡在滴管粗细交界处
shots.prompt_en: The cotton ball wedged snugly where the wide part of the dropper meets the narrow part. No people.
shots.narration: 卡紧在粗细交界的地方。

shots.scene: 棉花上方铺一层白色细粉
shots.prompt_en: A thin layer of fine white powder sits on top of the cotton inside the dropper. No people.
shots.narration: 棉花上可加一层硅藻土。

shots.scene: 很小的颗粒被细粉拦住
shots.prompt_en: Tiny particles are caught by the fine powder layer. No people.
shots.narration: 它能拦住非常细小的颗粒。

shots.scene: 过滤滴管夹在铁架台上，下方放一个小瓶
shots.prompt_en: The filter dropper is clamped on a ring stand with a small collection vial underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤滴管夹在铁架台上，下面放小瓶。

shots.scene: 另一支滴管吸取黑色混合物，转入过滤滴管
shots.prompt_en: A second dropper draws up a dark mixture and transfers it into the filter dropper. No people.
shots.narration: 用另一支滴管把混合物转进去。

shots.scene: 清澈的滤液一滴滴落入小瓶
shots.prompt_en: Clear filtrate drips one drop at a time into the vial. No people.
shots.narration: 黑乎乎的混合物，滤下来变清了。

shots.scene: 吸球在滴管上方用力猛挤、棉花被顶出的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bulb squeezed hard on top of the dropper pushing the cotton out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用吸球加速？别挤得太猛。

shots.scene: 中途松开吸球、杂质被吸回的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bulb released halfway with impurities sucked back up, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开始挤了就别松手，免得吸回去。

shots.scene: 溶剂沿瓶壁冲下残留，再转入过滤滴管
shots.prompt_en: Solvent runs down the flask wall to pick up residue, then is transferred to the filter dropper. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里的残留，用溶剂冲下来过滤。

shots.scene: 滴管颈部：杂质层在细粉层上，下面是棉花
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the dropper neck: a dark impurity layer on top of the white powder, cotton below. No people.
shots.narration: 杂质都留在了硅藻土上面。

shots.section_title: 重力过滤先折扇形滤纸
shots.scene: 一张折好的扇形滤纸像星星
shots.prompt_en: A fluted filter paper shaped like a star. No people.
shots.narration: 重力过滤，先把滤纸折成扇形。
overlay: 重力过滤先折扇形滤纸

shots.scene: 手指用力压出硬折痕、滤纸破洞的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger pressing a hard crease and the paper tearing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻折，别把折痕压死，容易破。

shots.scene: 圆滤纸先对折，展开后换方向再对折
shots.prompt_en: A round filter paper folded in half, opened, then folded in half the other way. No people.
shots.narration: 先对折，展开，换个方向再对折。

shots.scene: 捏住底部往里推，滤纸形成X形
shots.prompt_en: Fingers pinch the bottom and push in, and the paper forms an X shape. No people.
shots.narration: 捏住底部往里推，成一个X。

shots.scene: 反方向再做一次，分出四个大区
shots.prompt_en: The move is repeated the other way, giving four large sections. No people.
shots.narration: 反方向再推一次，分出四个区。

shots.scene: 一个区里推入折痕，折出两个小三角
shots.prompt_en: In one section the crease is pushed in and folded back into two small triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 每个区推入折痕，折出两个小三角。

shots.scene: 四个区都折好，折痕一正一反交替
shots.prompt_en: All four sections done; the folds alternate in and out around the paper. No people.
shots.narration: 四个区都这样，折痕一正一反。

shots.scene: 小研举起折好的扇形滤纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a finished fluted filter paper.
shots.narration: 扇形滤纸完成，多练几次就会。

shots.scene: 平铺滤纸和扇形滤纸对比，扇形接触面箭头更多
shots.prompt_en: A plain folded cone next to a fluted paper with many more contact arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 折成扇形，接触面更大，过滤更快。

shots.section_title: 漏斗大小合适，放好滤纸
shots.scene: 收集瓶上放漏斗，漏斗里放扇形滤纸
shots.prompt_en: A glass funnel of fitting size sits on a collection flask with a fluted filter paper inside. No people.
shots.narration: 漏斗大小合适，放进扇形滤纸。
overlay: 漏斗大小合适，放好滤纸

shots.scene: 小研把混合物倒到滤纸上，液面不超过滤纸边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the mixture onto the fluted paper, keeping the level below the paper edge.
shots.narration: 倒混合物，别倒太多溢出来。

shots.scene: 液面下降后再补加
shots.prompt_en: When the level drops, more mixture is added. No people.
shots.narration: 滤下去一些，再补加。

shots.section_title: 冲洗烧瓶和滤纸各三次
shots.scene: 滴管吸溶剂冲洗烧瓶，洗液倒到滤纸上
shots.prompt_en: A dropper rinses the flask with solvent and the washings go onto the filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 用溶剂冲洗烧瓶，洗液也过滤。
overlay: 冲洗烧瓶和滤纸各三次

shots.section_title: 冲洗烧瓶和滤纸各三次
shots.scene: 滴管沿滤纸转圈冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A dropper rinses around the filter paper in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸也要冲洗，各冲三次。

shots.scene: 取出滤纸放在表面皿上，旁边月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: The filter paper with solid is placed on a watch glass, with a moon icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 要固体，取出滤纸放表面皿上晾一夜。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着时钟，满脸着急
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances anxiously at a clock on the wall.
shots.narration: 赶时间？那就用减压过滤。

shots.scene: 大的布氏漏斗和小的赫氏漏斗并排
shots.prompt_en: A larger white flat-bottom filter funnel next to a smaller cone-shaped filter funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 布氏漏斗或赫氏漏斗，按量来选。

shots.scene: 两种漏斗之间一个约等号
shots.prompt_en: The two funnels with an approximately equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两者只是形状和大小不同。

shots.scene: 带侧管的抽滤瓶夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: A thick-walled side-arm filter flask clamped firmly to a ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶带侧管，一定要夹牢。

shots.scene: 头重脚轻的装置倾倒的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a top-heavy flask with a funnel tipping over, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装上漏斗头重脚轻，不夹会倒。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗套上橡胶垫圈插入瓶口
shots.prompt_en: The white filter funnel with a rubber adapter is pushed into the flask mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 漏斗加橡胶垫圈，插紧瓶口。

shots.scene: 扁平橡胶垫放在瓶口，漏斗压在上面
shots.prompt_en: A flat rubber filter adapter sits on the flask mouth and the funnel is pressed into it. No people.
shots.narration: 不够紧，就换扁平的橡胶垫。

shots.scene: 接口处漏气的小箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of air leaking at the joint, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 哪种都行，关键是密合不漏气。

shots.section_title: 滤纸盖住底部，不上侧壁
shots.scene: 圆滤纸平铺盖住漏斗底部所有小孔
shots.prompt_en: A round filter paper lies flat and covers all the holes at the bottom of the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸要盖住底部所有小孔。
overlay: 滤纸盖住底部，不上侧壁

shots.section_title: 滤纸盖住底部，不上侧壁
shots.scene: 滤纸边翘上侧壁的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of filter paper curling up the funnel wall, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但不能折到侧壁上。

shots.scene: 第二只抽滤瓶加橡胶塞，夹在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: A second side-arm flask with a rubber stopper and tube, clamped to the stand. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一个安全瓶，也要夹牢。

shots.scene: 管路示意：抽滤瓶—安全瓶—水泵
shots.prompt_en: A tubing diagram: filter flask side arm to the safety trap, safety trap side arm to the water pump. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶接安全瓶，安全瓶接水泵。

shots.scene: 水龙头水流冲过水泵，箭头显示空气被抽走
shots.prompt_en: Water rushes through a faucet water pump; arrows show air being pulled out of the flasks. No people.
shots.narration: 水流冲过水泵，把空气抽走。

shots.scene: 关泵时水倒流，被安全瓶拦住
shots.prompt_en: When the pump is turned off, water flows back and is stopped in the safety trap. No people.
shots.narration: 关泵时水可能倒吸，安全瓶拦住它。

shots.section_title: 用真空管路可直接连接
shots.scene: 抽滤瓶侧管直接接墙上的真空嘴
shots.prompt_en: The filter flask side arm is connected directly by tubing to a vacuum outlet on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 用实验室真空管路，可直接连接。
overlay: 用真空管路可直接连接

shots.scene: 小研打开水泵，滤纸被吸平
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, turns on the water pump fully and the filter paper is pulled flat.
shots.narration: 把水泵开足，滤纸被吸住。

shots.scene: 洗瓶润湿滤纸，紧贴底部
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle wets the filter paper so it sticks to the funnel base. No people.
shots.narration: 用溶剂润湿滤纸，让它贴紧。

shots.section_title: 倒在中央，分次加，冲洗三次
shots.scene: 混合物倒在漏斗正中间
shots.prompt_en: The mixture is poured into the center of the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 混合物倒在中间，分次加。
overlay: 倒在中央，分次加，冲洗三次

shots.section_title: 倒在中央，分次加，冲洗三次
shots.scene: 冲洗烧瓶和滤纸，三个水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The flask and the filter cake are rinsed, with three drop icons. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶和滤纸，照样各冲三次。

shots.section_title: 关泵：没接安全瓶先拔管
shots.scene: 关水泵的手
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns off the water pump faucet. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤结束，关掉水泵。
overlay: 关泵：没接安全瓶先拔管

shots.section_title: 关泵：没接安全瓶先拔管
shots.scene: 先拔管、再关泵的顺序箭头
shots.prompt_en: An order arrow: first a hand pulls the tube off the side arm, then the faucet is turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 没接安全瓶，一定先拔管再关泵。

shots.scene: 刮刀把滤纸从布氏漏斗里撬出
shots.prompt_en: A spatula lifts the filter paper with solid out of the white funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 用刮刀把滤纸取出来。

shots.scene: 滤纸放在表面皿上，月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: The filter paper rests on a watch glass, with a moon icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放在表面皿上，晾一夜。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 勺子猛倒细粉，粉尘飞扬的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fine powder dumped from a scoop with a dust cloud rising, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 硅藻土很细，取用时别扬起粉尘。

shots.scene: 小研戴防尘口罩和护目镜，在通风处轻轻取粉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dust mask and goggles, gently scoops fine powder at a ventilated bench.
shots.narration: 轻拿轻放，必要时戴防尘口罩。

shots.section_title: 过夜样品要标识、放指定处
shots.scene: 表面皿旁一张空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass with drying solid and a blank label card beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 过夜晾干的样品，要贴标签。
overlay: 过夜样品要标识、放指定处

shots.section_title: 过夜样品要标识、放指定处
shots.scene: 样品放进指定的柜子，公共台面上的无名样品被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The labeled sample is placed in a designated cabinet; an unlabeled dish on a shared bench is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放在指定位置，别留在公共台面。

shots.scene: 用手抓固体、凑近闻的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bare hand grabbing solid and a nose sniffing a flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 产物不用手碰，不闻不尝。

shots.scene: 刮刀和镊子打勾
shots.prompt_en: A spatula and tweezers with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 取样用刮刀、镊子。

shots.scene: 小研关水龙头、拔掉电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns off the water tap and unplugs equipment at the end of the day.
shots.narration: 做完了，关水、断电。

shots.scene: 水、电、气、门窗四个图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons getting green checks one by one: a water tap, a plug, a gas valve, and a window with a door. No people.
shots.narration: 离开前，水电气门窗都检查一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现棉球滴管和硅藻土图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cotton-plugged dropper and a powder layer.
shots.narration: 微量过滤：棉球塞紧，吸球别松。

shots.scene: 扇形滤纸和三个水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fluted filter paper and three rinse drops. No people.
shots.narration: 重力过滤：扇形滤纸，冲洗三次。

shots.scene: 夹牢的抽滤瓶和安全瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clamped filter flask and a safety trap. No people.
shots.narration: 减压过滤：夹牢、密合、接安全瓶。

shots.scene: 先拔管后关泵、口罩、标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pulling the tube before turning off the pump, a dust mask and a sample label. No people.
shots.narration: 先拔管再关泵，防尘、标识要做好。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张扇形滤纸挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a fluted filter paper and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 耐心过滤，干净利落，下次见！
